selection_rubric_application.free_data_readiness: both selected families use only daily raw OHLCV, official splits/distributions, and the frozen calendar
selection_rubric_application.schedule_cost_capacity: A5-IDIO <= 5.0x two-way/yr structural budget; TOM-SETTLE exactly 4.80x two-way/yr; both inside the 6.0x ceiling
selection_rubric_application.control_separates_from_beta: A5-IDIO sign-inverted control (opposite trigger, opposite predicted alpha sign); TOM mid-month placebo (identical gross schedule, no settlement clock)
selection_rubric_application.event_sufficiency: TOM ~24-29 windows per fold; A5-IDIO ~11-13 episodes per fold under the rolling 5/252 budget, fold-1 concentration predeclared with drop-one-fold death rule
selection_rubric_application.implementation_risk: TOM LOW (pure calendar, close-fill native); A5-IDIO MEDIUM resolved by the execution-clock adjudication below
selection_rubric_application.primary_source_trace: TOM: Ogden 1990 JF, Lakonishok-Smidt 1988 RFS, LSTV 1991 AER; A5-IDIO: Lehmann 1990 QJE, Jegadeesh 1990 JF, Lo-MacKinlay 1990 RFS, Nagel 2012 RFS, Cheng-Madhavan 2009
selection_rubric_application.tie_break: not required - two distinct winning families

adjudications.objection: A7 MEDIUM: proposal declares entry/exit at the regular-session OPEN of t+1, but the canonical V3 factory fill event is the session CLOSE (factory.value_book)
adjudications.resolution: executable spec frozen to the canonical fill event: signal computed from completed session t (PIT), fills at the CLOSE of session t+1; anchor/control hold 5 sessions close-to-close (exit fill at close of entry+5), neighbour 10; same-close switch allowed when both orders were decided at prior closes. Applied symmetrically to all three arms before any scoring; turnover/cost arithmetic unchanged (same legs, same notional); multi-session reversion mechanism unchanged

adjudications.objection: three proposals (A4-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL, A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL, A6-IDIO-SHOCK-REV) are one mechanism cluster
adjudications.resolution: exactly one selected (SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL); the other two remain frozen proposal documents, never scored, and their IDs are added to the within-cycle non-selectable list

adjudications.objection: A7 MEDIUM: no structural turnover governor
adjudications.resolution: moot - family not selected; recorded as lessons for future cycles

families.universe: 10 sector ETFs XLK XLE XLF XLV XLI XLP XLY XLU XLB XLRE (SPY = factor/benchmark only, never traded)
families.signal: z_i(t) = (r_i,t - beta_i(t)*r_SPY,t)/sigma_i(t); beta = trailing-60-session OLS slope on issuer-TR returns incl. t; epsilon ddof=0; completed-session PIT only

arms.trigger: z <= -3.0; select smallest z; tie -> alphabetically first symbol
arms.episode_budget: max 5 new entries per rolling 252 sessions, concurrency 1, chronological

vol_scaling_rule.note: constant scale = arm's expected average gross (5x5x0.5/252=0.0248)

arms.theory: liquidity-provision compensation accrues over days-to-weeks (Nagel/Lehmann); guards K=5 knife-edge

arms.trigger: z >= +3.0; select largest z; otherwise identical to A1
arms.predicted_alpha_sign: non-positive; positive-or->=50% control alpha falsifies the mechanism (sign-agnostic drift, not reversion)

families.clocks: decision at close of completed session t; fills at close of session t+1 (ADJ-1); same-close switch PIT-clean
falsification_rules: anchor incremental alpha <= 0 overall or positive in < 2/3 folds
neighbour alpha strictly opposite sign to anchor
anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0 or stress PF < 1.00 at 20 bps/side
realized two-way turnover > 6.0x/yr or any budget/concurrency breach

families.universe: all 11 cohort ETFs as one equal-weight basket; SPY traded here (basket member)
families.signal: calendar only: regular-session month ordinals; no estimation, no price-derived state

books.cash: residual to 1.0, never a tradable leg

arms.window: last 3 regular sessions of month M + first 2 of M+1
first 3 regular sessions of month M only (month-start settlement channel)
arms.theory: Ogden's settlement channel isolated; support = same sign as anchor in >= 2/3 folds; if neighbour alpha < 50% of anchor's, premium is month-END-dominated (window dressing) - predeclared attribution

arms.window: regular-session ordinals 8-12 of each month (mid-month, disjoint from anchor window for all month lengths)
arms.predicted_alpha_sign: ~0; same-sign control with |alpha| >= 50% of anchor's falsifies (schedule earns the same 'premium' with no clock)

families.clocks: decision at close of completed session T for the fill at close of T+1 (canonical close-fill); 24 transitions/yr; windows straddling fold/purge boundaries lose those scored sessions, no compensation trades
falsification_rules: anchor incremental alpha <= 0 or positive in < 2/3 folds
control same-sign as anchor AND |control alpha| >= 0.5*|anchor alpha|
neighbour alpha opposite-signed to anchor in >= 2/3 folds
stress PnL <= 0 or stress PF < 1.00 at 20 bps/side
schedule turnover > 6.0 two-way/yr or max fold MDD > 15% or any fold PF < 0.80 or drop-one failures

shared_contract.fills: raw prices at the canonical close-fill event; no same-day return on new weights
shared_contract.signals: issuer-TR path (raw + official distributions + official splits); distributions never create synthetic shocks
shared_contract.accounting: canonical research/assets/stocks/factory.py; CASH never in tradable-leg turnover; costs charged exactly once; attribution reconciles at 1e-12
shared_contract.incremental_alpha: after-cost strategy return minus risk-matched SPY per fold; require_beta_isolation=True for pass eligibility; raw PnL/PF never pass-eligible alone
shared_contract.stage_a_gates: as frozen in the blind packet (expectancy>0, PF>=1.10, >=2/3 folds positive, no fold PF<0.80, MDD<=15%, per-arm positive-fold share<=50%, no ETF>35% positive PnL, stress PnL>0 & PF>=1.00, turnover inside gate, risk-matched excess >=2/3 folds, incremental alpha>0, neighbour support, control falsification, drop-one-ETF & drop-one-fold survival, exact reproduction, zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL)
shared_contract.stress_and_dropone: stress = full arm at 2x costs; drop-one-ETF = per factory.select_drop_one_symbol (largest realized absolute-weight contribution, lexicographic tie-break); drop-one-fold = remove each fold and require surviving gates

post_freeze_rule: after the first scored metric: no freeze amendment, no substitute arm, no threshold change, no window reshape, no ETF substitution (PLAN section 12)
non_selected_pool: SFV3-A6-IDIO-SHOCK-REV (within-cycle cluster duplicate; A7 turnover objection recorded)
